name: Feather Promises
source:
You have just arrived in a new city in California the sunshine state. One last minute decision ends up affecting the rest of your day.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=22001]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]

你剛剛來到陽光普照的加州的一座新城市。臨時作出的一個決定，影響了你這一天剩下的時光。
